# Vouch

> Vouch is an open-source credential broker that replaces long-lived secrets (AWS keys, SSH keys, GitHub PATs, registry tokens) with short-lived credentials after FIDO2 hardware verification. One YubiKey tap, up to 8 hours of access, full audit trail.

Vouch replaces static secrets in the development workflow. It federates identity through OIDC, so every credential is tied to a verified hardware key and expires automatically — no key rotation scripts, offboarding checklists, or secrets in config files are required.

Every HTML page on vouch.sh is also served as raw Markdown at the same URL (e.g. `/docs/getting-started/index.md`). Token counts below are approximate (chars ÷ 4).

- [Source code](https://github.com/vouch-sh/vouch)
- [Agent capability manifest](https://vouch.sh/agents.md)
- [Full documentation for LLMs](https://vouch.sh/llms-full.txt)
